Name: HxW Boutique Furniture for Alternative Textures
Author: Wildflourmods
Description:
[center][/center][center]﻿[img]https://i.imgur.com/ms2H7PJ.png[/img]﻿


[size=4]Wisteria's High End Boutique Furniture from the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17404]Ferngill Fashion Festival[/url]﻿ Mod now as an AT Pack!

Decorate the boutique of your dreams with gorgeous mannequins, hats, dresses and other fashion-forward furniture!

This pack only requires AT and provides retextures using the vanilla base game furniture. Please be sure to see the required mods section.

Note: A few pieces were omitted due to size restraints and the big curtain doesn't sit flush with the wall because the Tree of the Winter Star can't do that. If you want the fully functional CP version of the furniture, check out the Ferngill Fashion Festival Mod linked above!
